items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of file attachments linked to the specified control test.

Results are returned in [JSON:API](https://jsonapi.org/) format. Use the `links.prev` and `links.next` URLs in the response to navigate between pages.

items.docs:
Download an attachment file by attachment ID.

Returns `200 OK` with the file content when the attachment is stored locally, or `302 Found` with a `Location` header pointing to a pre-signed S3 URL when the file is stored remotely.
